title: FY27 Scott AFB Air Show Audio Service
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE > AIR MOBILITY COMMAND > FA4407  375 CONS LGC
description: The 375th Contracting Squadron at Scott AFB, IL is contemplating an award for audio service for a air show located at Scott AFB, IL. Requested Period of Performance is approximately 5 days (10 June 2027 – 14 June 2027), covering transport, setup, live show days, teardown, and post-event departure. Please review the Performance Work Statement (PWS) and Request for Quote (RFQ) in their entirety, and submit a comprehensive proposal that addresses all stated requirements.
